recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-28608 unless a future OO decision intentionally changes ObservationDefinition.subject semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-28608 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested replacing ObservationDefinition.subject[x] 0..1 CodeableConcept|Reference(Group) with ObservationDefinition.subject 0..* CodeableConcept because ObservationDefinition defines kinds of subjects, not actual Group subjects.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation in stages. Commits 1872b9243b53a169bebb90fb52e09a217ea4b071 / 56b91f72c1e36104fa43f12c189891648867d5bd removed subject[x] and Reference(Group), introducing ObservationDefinition.subject as CodeableConcept, and f4f1df7c14521468c7e7048ef896c6b4705f6ca4 changed the cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*.
additional_context: ObservationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip thread records the concern that a Group reference did not make sense as a subject type and asks why the element was not 0..* code instead. OO minutes on 2020-12-17 record the current/requested text and a 13-0-4 motion to accept the catalog block vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch defines ObservationDefinition.subject with min 0, max *, type CodeableConcept, and the observation-subject-type binding; a stale-reference check found no remaining subject[x] or Reference(Group) text in the authoritative ObservationDefinition StructureDefinition source.
